fact: Decree 2023-1740 of 12 October 2023 approved the 2023-2026 National Safety Net Programme concept document, under which the programme is to build on Lisungi's Beneficiary Management Registry (RGB, under review) or set up its own, deployed in a government data centre, with 3 servers and 500 tablets to be acquired.
title: Décret n° 2023-1740 du 12 octobre 2023 portant approbation du document conceptuel du programme national de filets sociaux 2023-2026
publisher: Journal officiel de la République du Congo
